AbstractPeople at different ages and with different educational background have different migration patterns. However, international migration flows by age and educational attainment are scarce and not always comparable. We use a super learning algorithm with multiple initial models to estimate age and education composition of male and female immigrants for 199 countries over six five-year periods from 1990–1995 to 2015–2020.

AbstractDisambiguating research entities remains a long-standing methodological problem in scientometric analyses, as inconsistencies and ambiguous metadata limit the interoperability of major bibliographic databases. While global systems such as OpenAlex provide extensive coverage, they often lack the granularity and accuracy provided by national-level research databases. This study proposes a large-scale methodology to enhance author and institutional disambiguation by integrating local (Lattes and CAPES) and global (OpenAlex) databases.

Abstract Effective implementation of school-based health program depends on successful pre-implementation, which may influence program adoption, delivery, and outcomes. Despite its importance, pre-implementation remains underexplored. The Generation Healthy kids (GHK) study examined factors influencing pre-implementation of a multicomponent health promotion program in Danish primary schools from a school management perspective using the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research (CFIR).

abstract: Landmines remain a significant threat in many regions recovering from conflict, causing injuries, loss of life, and slowing down economic and social progress.
